confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge; no live menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable; July accommodation is least certain and could vary roughly 20-30% with dates and events. Cocktail and wine were set against the beer anchor (wine slightly below beer, cocktail about 1.7x beer) because local bar pricing is less certain. EUR prices were converted at an assumed rate, not a live quote. Accommodation anchors likely exclude Florence's per-person tourist tax. FX value taken from rba.gov.au search results, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Benchmarked against other large Italian historic-centre tourist cities such as Rome, Venice and Bologna from general knowledge, with July accommodation reflecting Florence's strong peak-season demand.
